Toggle navigation Menu --> Guitar Accessories → Guitar Pedals → Orange Amplification FUR-COAT Fur Coat Fuzz Blue SKU:^FUR-COAT Fuzz Blue View Larger Image Orange Amplification FUR-COAT Fur Coat SKU:7002-Fur Coat Description Reviews Choose the exact instrument Description Vintage Fuzz Loosely based on the vintage Foxx Tone Machine, the Orange Fur Coat takes its inspiration from great fuzz pedals of the 70s. The Fur Coat gives you a fully controllable octave fuzz pedal. Separate switches mean you can choose between Fuzz or Octave Fuzz. The controllable Octave up fuzz means you can bring in the fuzz to whatever level you need and the EQ allows you to boost your Treble or Bass. This truly is a fuzz you control. This is our only True Bypass pedal. This is because a Fuzz is better at the beginning of the chain where it interacts directly with your guitar. Placing the pedal further into your signal chain or after a buffer will give the fuzz a more distorted tone.
